genes.name: fekete_start
genes.hypothesis: Cyclic shifts of the Legendre sequence modulo the smallest prime p >= n + 1 are classical flat +-1 polynomials (71 is prime, so for n = 70 they are exact shifted Fekete polynomials). Starting from the best shift, and restarting from random shifts, puts the tabu walk in a better basin than random signs.
genes.predicted: lower score at n = 70 and n = 60 (n + 1 prime) at short budgets; little or nothing at n = 50 and n = 90, where the truncated sequence of a larger prime is used
genes.author: seed

genes.name: kick_restart
genes.hypothesis: Good flat polynomials are clustered: a restart from the best sequence with a few random flips (iterated local search) finds better optima than a restart from random signs, which forgets everything.
genes.predicted: -0.005 to -0.02 in score at budgets of a few seconds
genes.author: seed

genes.name: lp_surrogate
genes.hypothesis: The grid maximum is flat almost everywhere for single flips (most flips do not touch the peak), so the tabu walk is nearly blind. The L_2q norm on the grid (sum of |g|^(2q)) sees every peak at once and gives a smoother landscape whose minimisers still have a small maximum.
genes.predicted: lower score at all n; the exponent lp_q matters
genes.author: seed

genes.name: grid_mult
genes.hypothesis: Grid points per coefficient (M = grid_mult * n). A coarse grid makes each move cheaper but lets the surrogate miss peaks between grid points.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: tenure
genes.hypothesis: Steps for which a flipped coefficient may not be flipped back; too short and the walk cycles, too long and it cannot reach nearby optima.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: tenure_rand
genes.hypothesis: Random extra tenure, uniform in 0..tenure_rand, to break cycles of fixed length.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: stall_limit
genes.hypothesis: Steps without a new best surrogate in this restart before restarting. Short walks sample more basins, long walks explore each one more deeply.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: kick_flips
genes.hypothesis: Number of random flips applied to the best sequence at a kick: too few and the walk falls back into the same optimum, too many and it is a random restart.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: lp_q
genes.hypothesis: Exponent q of the L_2q surrogate: large q approaches the maximum (sharper but blinder), small q approaches the merit factor (L4, smooth but a different objective).
genes.author: seed
